title: Technical Lead
summary: A technical lead is a senior engineer who still writes code but also guides a small team of about 4 to 8 developers: setting the design, reviewing code and making sure work ships on time. They sit inside a product or delivery team, between the developers and the engineering manager or product manager, and usually do not own hiring and appraisals.
dailyDuties: Review pull requests from the team and enforce coding standards
Write and ship code for the hardest parts of the feature
Lead design discussions and write design documents
Break stories into tasks and give estimates in sprint planning
Unblock developers and pair with juniors on tricky problems
Agree scope and timelines with the product manager
Keep the build and deploy pipeline green
